Name: Honey Extended English
Author: AylaGames
Description:
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/82TN81p/how-to-install.png[/img][/url]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348
4. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26321]Honey Extend[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26321
5. Unzip Honey Extend mod into Stardew Valley Mods folder in your files.
6. Install this mod and copy files over to the inside of the Honey Extend mod and [u]overwrite[/u] the files in there.
﻿- It is recommended to install Honey Extend via Stardrop and then go into the files manually and replace the i18n folder with my mod.

There is one file in this mod, and it's the i18n folder and the default.json in there is the only file modded.

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/St4vVV4/added-new-crafting-item-heavy-bee-hive.png[/img][/url]
﻿- Item unlocked after reaching farming skill 6.
﻿- Crafting material needed: 1 bee house, 25 hardwood
﻿- It can work in all seasons.
﻿- This hive requires more items for it to make honey. But at the same time, you get twice the honey. This is how you get the special honey exclusive to the mod.


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/xGr58K0/new-crafting-recipes-for-heavy-hives.png[/img][/url]
﻿- Adding sugar: yields two servings of regular honey.
﻿- Put in any item of fruit or flower type: two copies of honey of the corresponding type will be produced, selling for 100+ (raw material price * 2) (the                            same calculation formula as the original).
﻿- Put in Mystic Syrup: Produce two copies of Mystic Honey.
﻿- Add honey: a royal jelly of the corresponding category will be produced, and the price is the raw material price * 2.
﻿- Put in the mysterious honey: a piece of mysterious royal jelly will be produced, and the price is the raw material price * 2.
﻿- Put in coal: Produces a lot of...worm meat?


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/KjPqdh6/new-artisan-items-added.png[/img][/url]
﻿- Mystery honey
﻿- Royal Jelly and
﻿- Mysterious Royal Jelly
﻿- Royal Mead and
﻿- Mystic Mead
﻿- Both Royal Mead and Mystic Mead can be aged in wooden barrels.
﻿- In particular, drinking the mysterious mead will increase luck and speed.


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/q0PyF34/new-crafting-recipes-for-kegs.png[/img][/url]
﻿- Add royal jelly: royal mead is produced.
﻿- Add mysterious royal jelly: produce mysterious mead.


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/cy2pgNM/new-recipes-for-honey.png[/img][/url]
﻿- Hachimi Drink: Recipe can be purchased from Gus' shop using honey.
